title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive
Maidstone, Kent (Hybrid)
Hybrid working (3 days in the office / 2 from home)
32,000 - 38,000 + Uncapped Commission + Career Development
Start your sales career with a business that's changing the automotive industry.

We're looking for an ambitious, driven Business Development Executive to join a rapidly growing international organisation that works with some of the world's leading automotive manufacturers, suppliers and technology businesses.

If you're naturally competitive, enjoy speaking with people and love the idea of building relationships with global brands, we'd love to hear from you.

This isn't a call centre role and it isn't high-volume telesales.

You'll be introducing organisations to a globally recognised automotive network, helping them understand how corporate partnerships, sponsorship opportunities and industry events can support both their commercial goals and their people strategy.

As a Business Development Executive you will be working closely with the Founder and senior commercial team, you'll be responsible for generating new business opportunities across the UK and internationally.

Your day could include:
- Researching target organisations
- Prospecting through LinkedIn, email and outbound calls
- Booking meetings with senior decision makers
- Introducing companies to our membership and sponsorship opportunities
- Managing your own sales pipeline
- Updating the CRM
- Supporting the commercial team with international events and campaigns

You'll receive full training on our services, sales process and systems, giving you the tools to build a successful career in commercial sales.

We're far more interested in attitude than industry experience.

You'll ideally have:
- 1-3 years' experience in a Business Development, Sales Executive, SDR, BDR or similar commercial role
- Confidence speaking with senior professionals
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive, positive attitude
- The ability to work independently and a genuine desire to build a career in sales
- Be local to Maidstone, Kent

Experience within events, sponsorship, professional services or B2 B sales would be advantageous but isn't essential. This role will suit someone who:
- Loves speaking with people
- Enjoys winning new business
- Is resilient and doesn't give up after one "no"
- Takes ownership of their own workload
- Wants to learn from experienced commercial leaders
- Is motivated by commission and career progression
- 32,000- 38,000 basic salary
- Uncapped commission
- Hybrid working (3 days in the Maidstone office / 2 from home)
- Full sales training and ongoing mentoring
- Clear career progression as the commercial team grows
- Opportunity to attend international automotive events
- Work with globally recognised brands
- Join a business making a genuine impact on diversity across the automotive industry

EA First Ltd are acting as an Employment Agency for this permanent vacancy.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
My client, an established international manufacturer of dental materials, is currently recruiting for a Sales Coordinator to join their team.

This is a varied and important role, acting as a key link between customers, the Sales team and internal departments including Operations, Production, Quality Control, Artwork and Despatch.

You will be responsible for coordinating the sales process from customer enquiry through to order fulfilment, while also supporting artwork, export documentation and general sales administration.

What you will actually do -
- Manage customer enquiries via telephone and email, providing updates on orders, lead times, deliveries, collections and delays.
- Process sales orders and prepare relevant documentation using SAGE 200 and Microsoft Office.
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure orders are processed accurately and delivered on time.
- Maintain customer accounts, pricing, product information and sales records.
- Coordinate urgent and special customer requirements, ensuring clear communication across the business.
- Provide customers with product and quality documentation, including SDS sheets, Certificates of Analysis, Quality Certificates, Product Data Sheets and IFUs.
- Coordinate packaging artwork, including labels, IFUs and cartons, using CorelDRAW and Adobe Illustrator where required.
- Prepare export and shipping documentation, including Certificates of Origin, EUR1 forms, Batch Certificates and Commercial Invoices.
- Support Despatch, agents and export processes as required.
- Assist with sales reporting, month-end activities, exhibitions and wider sales administration.
- Provide support and cover for colleagues when required.

What You will need -
- 2+ years' experience in sales support, customer service, administration or a similar customer-facing role.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- Good Microsoft Office and Excel skills.
- Experience with SAGE or a similar CRM/ERP system is desirable.
- Experience with CorelDRAW or Adobe Illustrator would be advantageous.
- Knowledge of export documentation would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

You'll be a professional, organised and proactive individual who enjoys working in a busy, varied role. You'll have a strong customer focus, excellent attention to detail and the ability to communicate effectively with both customers and internal teams.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within an established international manufacturing business, with exposure across sales, customer service, operations, artwork and export.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Coordinator

Car is essential to this role, due to location.

About the Role

We are looking for an organised, proactive and customer-focused Sales Coordinator to support the sales team and ensure the sales process runs smoothly and efficiently.

The Sales Coordinator will act as an important link between sales representatives, customers and internal departments, including logistics, finance, warehouse, production and customer service. The role combines sales administration, customer communication, order coordination and reporting.

Key Responsibilities
- Process sales orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring all information is correctly entered into company systems.
- Support the sales team with quotations, proposals, presentations and sales reports.
- Respond to customer enquiries and provide timely updates on orders.
- Resolve basic customer issues and ensure queries are followed through appropriately.
- Liaise with warehouse, production and logistics teams to ensure customer orders are fulfilled on time.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, including CRM and Sage systems.
- Track sales activities and ensure relevant documentation is organised and maintained.
- Monitor product availability and coordinate stock requirements where necessary.
- Organise meetings, maintain calendars and provide administrative support for sales activities, events and exhibitions.
- Prepare sales performance reports and assist with analysing sales data for management.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the business to ensure a high level of customer service.

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong communication and customer service abilities.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Experience using CRM systems; knowledge of Sage would be advantageous.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a practical approach to resolving issues.
- The ability to multitask, prioritise workload and work effectively to deadlines.
- A collaborative approach with the ability to work well as part of a wider team.
- Previous experience in administration, customer service or sales support would be beneficial.

Qualifications
- GCSEs, A-levels or equivalent.
- A business-related qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Knowledge or experience of CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot or Microsoft Dynamics would be an advantage.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised and dependable.
- Customer-focused and professional.
- Proactive and able to use initiative.
- Comfortable working in a busy, varied environment.
- Detail-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy.
- A confident communicator who enjoys working with people.
- A team player who can build effective relationships across different departments.

Salary & Requirements

Salary: £26,000-£32,000 per annum, relative to experience.

A car is essential for this position.

The Opportunity

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys organisation, working with people and playing a key role in ensuring the sales process operates efficiently behind the scenes.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Summary:
Are you seeking a team that shares your passion for providing excellent customer service?
Are you a determined individual? Do you enjoy setting goals for yourself?
If so, this is a chance you won't want to pass up
This is a critical position within our fast-paced, friendly, and award-winning Customer Service team. You understand your customer's point of view and make them feel important. Your warmth, passion, and commitment will assist us in getting it right the first time for our customers.
No two days are the same. You'll help customers with water bills, refunds, payment plans, and occupant changes. You'll also be helpful if they have problems with their water supply. You enjoy working towards targets, love problem solving, and take satisfaction in delivering the best solutions possible.
The salary is £25,948.87. We also offer bonuses for meeting targets. You can earn an extra £3,000 on average and up to £6,300 in total. Monday through Friday, 08:00 - 19:00, and Saturday, 08:00 - 13:00. You'll be assigned to a shift pattern that includes one Saturday every six weeks. The rotas are created in advance so that you can plan.
Previous call centre experienceis preferred but not required. Ideally, you'll have experience in a customer facing or customer focused position. You're eager to learn and respond well to feedback. We provide thorough induction training, ongoing coaching, and the support and encouragement you need to get started well.
In our vibrant, friendlycall centre, you'll find plenty to do, including regular competitions, rewards, team nights, social events, and paid volunteering days to support issues you care about.
This position offers numerous prospects for progression. For example, most of our management began their careers as Customer Service Advisors. You'll have the opportunity to move throughout the department to learn new skills and try out for other roles. As a result, now is a perfect opportunity to launch a successful career and contribute to the success of our Customer Service team.
Main responsibilities:
- Provide an excellent customer experience by being flexible to resolve all customer contacts within the company timescales and contribute to customer satisfaction score.
- Maintain focus on meeting targets and adhere to business processes, data protection, regulatory compliance and attendance.
- Build relationships with peers and colleagues to enhance the team working environment, resolve customer problems and ensure successful productivity.
- Proactively use information and resources to ensure that skills and knowledge are kept up to date and continuously developed.
- Attend and contribute to team meetings with team, peers and colleagues.
- To be available to support the business in peak periods by covering post room and reception duties and by being part of a standby rota emergency periods.

You'll need:
Skills / Qualifications / Experience
- Achieved GCSE Maths and English at Grade 4/C (or equivalent)
- Commitment to providing excellent customer service
- Dedication to finding the best solutions to problems
- Excellent computer abilities
- Outstanding writing and vocal communication abilities

It will be a bonus if you have:
Skills / Qualifications / Experience
- Previous customer service / call centre experience would be advantageous

Employees are required to be flexible and to be prepared to perform duties and other tasks within their capabilities. The nature of our business is such that the contents of any job profile are subject to change from time to time.
We want to be the water company people want to be supplied by and want to work for.
We know the communities we serve are diverse. We recognise creativity comes from diversity not similarity. That's why we are enthusiastic about creating inclusion across age, race, gender, ethnicity, religion and identity. You will experience our dedication to equal opportunities and fair treatment for all: through your recruitment, employment and career progression with South East Water.
Benefits package:
- Excellent Stakeholder pension scheme, up to 10% employer contribution.
- 5 weeks holiday plus bank holidays per annum, increasing to 6 weeks with length of service.
- Flexible annual leave policy to buy or sell holiday leave.
- Paid volunteering days.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Health cash plan.
- Life assurance.
- Wellbeing related benefits.

What can you expect from your recruitment?
- To apply for this position, please submit your CV on our career's website.
- It is necessary for you to have the legal right to work in the UK when you begin employment with South East Water.
- Additionally, as part of the employment offer, you will need to pass background, identity, and employment referencing checks.

If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, apply now!

£25,948.87 starting salary + bonus
